candidate_policy.selection: Freeze legal structural candidate coordinates before future measurements; do not filter using historical PASS, D95, cycles, runtime or epsilon outcomes.
candidate_policy.f_search: An action may require multiple physical F probes; every probe and failure must have its own charged attempt. F is not a free oracle or one presumed final call.

comparison.epsilon_definition: A D95-verified action hits if its ATE cycles <= (1+epsilon)*minimum D95-verified cycles within the prospectively frozen pilot roster. No full-space optimum claim.
comparison.seed_origin: Proposed pilot design constants only; existing TRAIN seed provenance is not authenticated by this preparation.
comparison.epsilon_source: contracts/runtime_training_v2.json:scope.epsilon (0.01); preserve the historical 1 percent research target, not a looser 5 percent endpoint.
comparison.reporting: Report hits, no-hit/censored sessions, charged failures and incomplete costs; never silently keep hits only.

reuse.reason: Initial pilot disables reuse symmetrically until real materialization/restore costs and identities are measured; ledger cache support alone is not runtime integration proof.

conflicts: runtime_policy_v1 permits one transient retry; new pilot permits zero automatic retries
runtime_policy_v1 uses configured timeout when elapsed is absent; new pilot prohibits runtime imputation
runtime_policy_v1 enables prefix reuse and charges restore costs; real restore accounting is not integrated for new pilot
